name: CCA 976 烟雾警报 烟雾难以忍受

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 976, you are parking at gate 26, you have received information Papa, request ATC clearance to Beijing from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air China 976，停在 26 号登机口，已收到信息 Papa，向武汉放行请求前往 Beijing 的 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA976, gate 26, information P, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA976，26 号登机口，信息 P，请求前往 Beijing 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 976, cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, Zulu Foxtrot 01 departure, initial altitude 2700 meters, cruising level 8100 meters, after departure, contact 125.9, squawk 6563, runway in use 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，可以按计划航路前往 Beijing，Zulu Foxtrot 01 离场，初始高度 2700 米，巡航高度 8100 米，离场后联系 125.9，应答机 6563，使用跑道 04。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, ZF 01 departure, initial altitude 2700 meters, cruising level 8100 meters, after departure, contact 125.9, squawk 6563, runway in use 04, CCA976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Beijing，ZF 01 离场，初始高度 2700 米，巡航高度 8100 米，离场后联系 125.9，应答机 6563，使用跑道 04，CCA976。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 976, push back approved, report ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，推出批准，准备滑行时报告。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备滑行，联系武汉地面。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 976, there is a disabled Boeing 737 on the taxiway Alpha, follow the follow-me car on Alpha 9, hold short of runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，滑行道 Alpha 上有一架故障 Boeing 737，跟随 Alpha 9 上的引导车，在跑道 04 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Roger, follow the follow-me car on A9, hold short of runway 04, CCA976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跟随 A9 上的引导车，在跑道 04 前等待，CCA976。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 976, hold short of runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，在跑道 04 前等待。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 976, contact Wuhan Tower 118.2.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，联系武汉塔台118.2。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA976, ready for departure.

cards.audioText: C: Air China 976, traffic on 11 kilometers final, wind calm, cleared for immediate takeoff runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，11 公里五边有交通，风静，跑道 04 可以立即起飞。
cards.referenceText: Roger, cleared for immediate takeoff runway 04, CCA976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，CCA976。

cards.audioText: B: As you apply power, you hear a master warning alarm, tell Wuhan Tower you are stopping.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 当你加推力时，听到主警告警报，告诉 武汉塔台 你正在中止。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA976, stopping due to master warning.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA976，因主警告中止起飞。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 976, expedite taxi and vacated at Foxtrot, contact Ground when clear of runway.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，加快滑行并在 Foxtrot 脱离，脱离跑道后联系 地面。
cards.referenceText: Expedite taxi and vacated at F, contact Ground when clear of runway, CCA976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 加快滑行并在 F 脱离，脱离跑道后联系 地面，CCA976。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Ground you are clear of runway 04 at Foxtrot, and that you had to abort takeoff because flap setting is incorrect.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉 地面 你已在 Foxtrot 脱离跑道 04，并因襟翼设置不正确不得不中止起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA976, runway vacated at F, we had to abort takeoff due to incorrect flap setting.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA976，已在 F 脱离跑道，我们因襟翼设置不正确不得不中止起飞。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA976, ready for departure.

cards.audioText: C: Air China 976, line up runway 04.
C: Air China 976, cancel SID, maintain runway heading to 1500 meters, track direct to Zulu Foxtrot, runway 04, cleared for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，取消 SID，保持跑道航向到 1500 米，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，跑道 04，可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, maintain runway heading to 1500 meters, track direct to ZF, runway 04, cleared for takeoff, CCA976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，保持跑道航向到 1500 米，直飞 ZF，跑道 04，可以起飞，CCA976。

cards.audioText: B: During initial climb, you have a smoke warning, report it to Wuhan Departure and request immediate return for priority landing runway 04, this is a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 初始爬升期间，你有烟雾警告，向 Wuhan Departure 报告并请求立即返回跑道 04 优先着陆，这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Departure, CCA976, we have a smoke warning, request immediate return for priority landing runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，Wuhan Departure，CCA976，我们有烟雾警告，请求立即返回跑道 04 优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 976, climb to 900 meters, turn right heading 070, expect radar vector ILS runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，爬升到 900 米，右转航向 070，预计雷达引导 ILS 跑道 04。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 900 meters, turn right heading 070, expect radar vector ILS runway 04, CCA976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升到 900 米，右转航向 070，预计雷达引导 ILS 跑道 04，CCA976。

cards.audioText: B: Now the source of smoke can't be detected and is becoming unbearable, notify Wuhan Tower you hope to turn left, and make a landing on the nearest available runway 22, this is a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在烟源无法确定且变得难以忍受，通知 武汉塔台 你希望左转，并在最近可用跑道 22 着陆，这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: Mayday MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Tower, CCA976, the source of smoke can't be detected and is becoming unbearable, request turn left to make a landing on the nearest available runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉塔台，CCA976，烟源无法确定且变得难以忍受，请求左转在最近可用跑道 22 着陆。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 976, turn left heading 310, radar vector for a visual approach runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 976，左转航向 310，雷达引导目视进近跑道 22。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 310, radar vector for a visual approach runway 22, CCA976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 310，雷达引导目视进近跑道 22，CCA976。
